help.title: How to play
help.welcome: Welcome to Paisapur. You live one year of a money life. Every choice changes your cash, your savings and how calm you feel, and the town teaches you why.
help.move: Walk: arrow keys or WASD. On a phone, use the pad at the bottom.
help.talk: Talk to people, read signs, open doors: Z, Enter or Space (the A button).
help.back: Go back or close something: X or Esc (the B button).
help.menu: Open the menu: M or the MENU button. Bag, Journal, Wallet, Help and Feedback are all there.
help.goal: Follow the line at the bottom of the screen that starts with the target icon. It always says where to go next. Talk to everyone: people give you jobs, advice and badges.
help.learn: People in town teach you an idea, then you try it with your own money. Mini-games and quizzes check that it stuck. New ideas land in your Journal, and the Feedback screen shows how you are doing.

tip.0: Walk up to a person or a door and press Z to talk or go in. Your first stop is Professor Arth's Money Lab, shown in the line at the bottom of the screen.
tip.1: A bank account keeps money safe and lets you pay without cash. Visit the bank and open one. Bring what the counter asks for.
tip.2: Needs come before wants. Split what you earn into jars, and check what each thing really costs before you pay.
tip.3: Surprises happen. Savings you set aside early are what get you through a bad month. Look at Months covered in the top bar.
tip.4: Borrowing costs more than the amount you borrow. Compare the full repayment before you sign. Never borrow for something you merely want.
tip.5: Money can grow, and it can fall. Spread it around, think long term, and never put in what you cannot afford to lose.
tip.6: If a deal sounds too good to be true, it is. Check who is offering it, never share OTPs or PINs, and ask someone you trust.

help.moreBody: Stuck on an idea? These are outside the game and do not change your story. Save first (Menu, then Save).
help.generic: Follow the line at the bottom of the screen, and talk to people you meet.

feedback.title: How you are doing
feedback.toReviewBody: You have met these ideas but not mastered them yet. Open the Journal to read them again, or try a lesson.
feedback.allGood: Nothing to review yet. Keep going and new ideas will show up here.

decision.saved: Your game is saved before you go.

meet_prof.where: North-west of the town square: the Money Lab.
meet_prof.step1: Walk to the Lab door and press Z to go in.
meet_prof.step2: Talk to Professor Arth. He explains the next idea and sets your next job.
meet_prof.step3: Lost? The line at the bottom of the screen always names the next place.

open_account.where: Paisapur Bank, east of the Lab.
open_account.step1: Go into the bank and talk to Meena Rao at the counter.
open_account.step2: She asks for your KYC documents. If you do not have them yet, go home and ask Mom.
open_account.step3: With the documents, she opens your account. After that, the bank screen is where you manage your money.

get_docs.step1: Walk home and talk to Mom.
get_docs.step2: Choose the documents a bank really needs. Pick carefully.
get_docs.step3: Then take them to Meena Rao at the bank.

back_to_bank.step1: Talk to Meena Rao at the counter.
back_to_bank.step2: Hand over your documents and answer her questions to open the account.

tell_mom.step1: Walk home and talk to Mom.
tell_mom.step2: Tell her the news. A new idea can follow.

buyer_outside.step1: Step outside and talk to the buyer about your old cycle.
buyer_outside.step2: Think about the price before you agree to anything.

meena_challenge.step1: Talk to Meena Rao and take her challenge.
meena_challenge.step2: It checks the banking ideas you have just learned. Wrong answers show you the idea again.

ch2_prof.where: The Money Lab, north-west of the square.
ch2_prof.step1: Go to the Lab and talk to Professor Arth.

ch2_month.step1: Go to Zaroorat Store and buy what you need this month. Needs come before wants.
ch2_month.step2: Open MENU and then Wallet to see how much you have left before you spend.
ch2_month.step3: When you are done, go home and sleep. Sleeping ends the month.

ch2_pyf.step1: Visit Professor Arth. He has a saving trick for you.
ch2_pyf.step2: Try it with your own money next month.

ch2_month2.step1: Earn and spend by the budget you made.
ch2_month2.step2: Check MENU, then Wallet, to stay on budget.
ch2_month2.step3: Go home and sleep to finish the month.

anwar_challenge.step1: Talk to Anwar Chacha and take his challenge.
anwar_challenge.step2: It checks the budgeting ideas from this chapter.

ch3_home.step1: Walk home and sleep. A rest ends the chapter's first part.

ch3_lakshmi.step1: Find Lakshmi Aunty in the square and talk to her.
ch3_lakshmi.step2: She explains why a safety net matters.

ch3_fund.where: The bank, then the town square.
ch3_fund.step1: Go to the bank and put money into savings.
ch3_fund.step2: Watch the lifebelt number in the top bar. It counts the months of needs your savings cover. You need 3.
ch3_fund.step3: When you have 3, take Lakshmi Aunty's challenge.

lakshmi_challenge.step1: Talk to Lakshmi Aunty and take her challenge.

ch4_prof.step1: Talk to Professor Arth about your big goal.
ch4_prof.step2: He sets up the borrowing chapter.

ch4_compare.where: The bank, and the moneylender's house.
ch4_compare.step1: Visit Mr. Iyer at the bank and the moneylender. Ask each what you would repay in total.
ch4_compare.step2: Compare the full amount you pay back, not just the monthly figure.
ch4_compare.step3: Then decide how you want to borrow, if at all.

ch4_iyer.step1: Live with your choice for two months: earn, repay and sleep.
ch4_iyer.step2: Then go to the bank and take Mr. Iyer's challenge.

ch5_prof.step1: Talk to Professor Arth. Something big is happening in town.

ch5_bonds.where: The Bond Office, north of the main road.
ch5_bonds.step1: Walk to the Bond Office and talk to the clerk.
ch5_bonds.step2: Buy a town bond. A bond is a loan to the town that pays you back with interest.

ch5_sleep.step1: Go home and sleep. The bridge will be ready next month.

ch5_exchange.where: Across the new bridge: the Deccan Exchange.
ch5_exchange.step1: Cross the bridge and go into the Exchange.
ch5_exchange.step2: Look at the prices and the news before you buy anything.

ch5_invest.step1: Invest a little. Only put in what you could afford to see go down.
ch5_invest.step2: Stay invested until month 10. Sleeping at home moves time on.

ch6_prof.step1: Talk to Professor Arth. Something is wrong in Deccan City.

ch6_investigate.step1: Go to Deccan City and look into Double Dhamaka.
ch6_investigate.step2: Ask yourself who is offering it, and what they want from you.

ch6_report.step1: Go to Inspector Fatima and report Double Dhamaka.
ch6_report.step2: Say what you saw and what you were asked for.

end.step1: Visit Professor Arth for your year-end review.

new_goal.step1: Keep saving for your goal. Open MENU, then Wallet, to see your progress.
new_goal.step2: Earn, spend carefully and sleep to end each month.
